meta.description: How Yaqeen Advisory collects, uses and protects personal information submitted through this website.

heading: Privacy policy
body:
This policy explains how Yaqeen Advisory ("we", "us") handles personal information collected through this website. It covers website visitors and people who contact us. Client engagements are governed separately by the engagement letter and confidentiality terms.

## Information we collect

- **Enquiry details.** When you use the contact form we collect your name, email address, phone or WhatsApp number (optional), company, country and the message you write.
- **Technical data.** Our website host and, if enabled, our analytics tool may record your IP address, device and browser type, and the pages you visit.

## How we use it

- To reply to your enquiry and send a proposal you have asked for.
- To keep the website secure and understand which pages are useful.
- To meet legal obligations.

We do not sell your personal information.

## Who we share it with

We use service providers to run the website, receive form submissions and (optionally) measure traffic. They process data on our behalf under their own terms. We may disclose information where the law requires it.

## Where data is processed

Service providers may process data outside your country. We take reasonable steps to ensure appropriate protection, in line with applicable law, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and data-protection laws in the UAE and Saudi Arabia where they apply.

## How long we keep it

Enquiry details are kept for as long as needed to respond and for a reasonable period afterwards. If you become a client, information is handled under your engagement terms.

## Your choices

You can ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information you have sent us by emailing us at the address on our contact page.

## Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
